# Hello!

:::{.incremental}
::: {style="font-size: 110%;"}
- My name is **Pierre**, nice to meet you all!

 - I'm currently working as a **research engineer** in Inria/INSA team **Emeraude**, working among other things on a PhD Thesis intitled *Compilation and Optimization methods for Digital Audio Signal Processing and Synthesis on hardware architectures*.

- I'm mainly a **software engineer**, a bit specialized in **audio** and **compilation**, I'm involved in the development/maintenance of tools such as:
  - **Syfala** (Faust-to-FPGA compilation toolchain)
  - **FloPoCo/HAriCo** (Hardware Arithmetic Core Generator)
  - **Emeraude-MLIR** (Compilation framework)
  - **Faust** (but not really...)
:::
:::

# Faust (Functional Audio Stream)

## Faust

::: {.incremental style="font-size: 95%;"}
- **FAUST** is a programming language specifically made for audio DSP and synthesis. It was created by **Yann Orlarey**, **Dominique Fober** & **Stéphane Letz** at **GRAME** in 2002.

  - **Functional** paradigm,
  - Declarative, ***math-like*** syntax
  - Produces **optimized code** for many architectures
  - Not recommended (yet) for multi-rate (**FFT**)
  - **Plugins**: VST, CLAP, AudioUnit
  - **Software**: **JUCE**, VCV Rack, Max, Pd, SuperCollider, Csound, ...
  - **OS**: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS,
  - **Embedded**: Bela, Teensy, Daisy, ESP32, FPGA...
  - **Code**: **C/C++**, Rust, WASM, Java...
- **Tutorials** & **documentation** available at [https://faust.grame.fr](https://faust.grame.fr)
- Dedicated online **IDE**: [https:://faustide.grame.fr](https:://faustide.grame.fr)
:::
